upgrades.name: Sharpened
upgrades.description: Deal 20% more damage.

upgrades.name: Quick Spin
upgrades.description: Your weapon spins 20% faster.

upgrades.name: Long Blade
upgrades.description: Your weapon is 20% longer.

upgrades.name: Heavy Blade
upgrades.description: Your weapon is 50% thicker, so it hits and blocks more.

upgrades.name: Compact
upgrades.description: Your ball is 12% smaller: a harder target.

upgrades.name: Thorns
upgrades.description: Whoever hits you takes 30% of the damage back.

upgrades.name: Vitality
upgrades.description: +25 max HP.

upgrades.name: Swift
upgrades.description: Your ball moves 15% faster.

upgrades.name: Focus
upgrades.description: Your ability cooldown is 25% shorter, or a Gun's reload 15% (each copy shortens what is left).

upgrades.name: Armor
upgrades.description: Take 1 less damage from every hit (but never less than half).

upgrades.name: Lifesteal
upgrades.description: Hits heal you for 25% of the damage dealt.

upgrades.name: Critical Hits
upgrades.description: 15% chance for a hit to deal double damage.

upgrades.name: Shield Bash
upgrades.description: Blocking a hit with your shield deals 1 damage back.

upgrades.name: Wide Swipe
upgrades.description: Your sword is 40% longer during Spin Swipe.

upgrades.name: Spiked Shield
upgrades.description: Your shield deals 2 damage to enemies it touches.

upgrades.name: Long Swipe
upgrades.description: Spin Swipe keeps spinning for an extra half turn.

upgrades.name: Big Shield
upgrades.description: Your shield is 50% wider.

upgrades.name: Long Dash
upgrades.description: Charge Dash travels 40% further.

upgrades.name: Quick Charge
upgrades.description: Charge Dash winds up twice as fast (each copy halves what is left).

upgrades.name: Braced
upgrades.description: Take 60% less damage while charging and dashing (each copy cuts what is left).

upgrades.name: Rapid Growth
upgrades.description: Your spear grows 50% more with every hit.

upgrades.name: Deadly Crits
upgrades.description: Critical hits deal +100% damage (triple instead of double).

upgrades.name: Quick Recovery
upgrades.description: Your daggers can parry the same weapon again twice as soon (each copy halves what is left).

upgrades.name: Momentum
upgrades.description: Your daggers gain 50% more spin speed per hit.

upgrades.name: Close Quarters
upgrades.description: Your hits knock enemies back 40% less, keeping them in reach (each copy cuts what is left).

upgrades.name: Evasion
upgrades.description: +12% chance to dodge a hit completely.

upgrades.name: Rebound
upgrades.description: Bouncing off a wall makes you 40% faster for a moment.

upgrades.name: Quick Drop
upgrades.description: Drop Slam gains 12.5% more damage from the height it falls.

upgrades.name: Heavy Impact
upgrades.description: Drop Slam gains 50% more damage from the height it falls.

upgrades.name: High Bounce
upgrades.description: Drop Slam bounces you back up off the floor at +100% speed, and every other bounce off the floor gets +50% speed upwards.

upgrades.name: Great Mace
upgrades.description: Your mace is 40% longer during Drop Slam.

upgrades.name: Meteor
upgrades.description: Drop Slam homes in on the enemy 25% better as it falls.

upgrades.name: Quick Repair
upgrades.description: Swatted drones tumble for 30% less time, and once back they can attack again 30% sooner (each copy cuts what is left).

upgrades.name: Quick Production
upgrades.description: Start with 1 more drone (and build up to 1 more).

upgrades.name: Defense Matrix
upgrades.description: Each guarding drone takes twice as much off a hit, and the guard can take off 10% more of it in all.

upgrades.name: Boosters
upgrades.description: Your drones fly 40% faster, attacking and catching up with the formation.

upgrades.name: Spiked Drones
upgrades.description: Whoever swats one of your drones takes 0.25 damage.

transformations.name: Stalwart
transformations.description: Gain a second, smaller shield. Both sit behind you in a Y, with your sword as its stem. The weight slows your spin by 15%.

transformations.name: Wildling
transformations.description: Landing a hit with Spin Swipe wards you: the next hit you take does nothing.

transformations.name: Dizzy
transformations.description: Spin Swipe spins two extra full turns.

transformations.name: Captain
transformations.description: Every 4 s, throw your shield at the enemy for 2 damage (plus its own contact damage, like spikes). It flies back to you, but can't block while it's away.

transformations.name: Fire Eater
transformations.description: Every 3 s your blade catches fire. Your next hit sets the enemy burning for 1 damage every 0.5 s for 3 s.

transformations.name: Piercer
transformations.description: After every Spin Swipe, lunge at the enemy sword-first for a big stab. Spin Swipe's cooldown is 50% longer.

transformations.name: Dual Wielder
transformations.description: Swap your shield for a short second sword. It still blocks, deals 3 damage to enemies it touches (+0.5 each time your sword hits), and gets your shield upgrades.

transformations.name: Gladiator
transformations.description: Every 4 s, throw a net at the enemy. If it lands they're 50% slower and take 50% more damage for 2.5 s.

transformations.name: Hoplite
transformations.description: Gain a shield like the Sword's, just to the left of your spear. It blocks enemy weapons.

transformations.name: Poseidon
transformations.description: Your spear becomes a trident with a big head. Hitting with the head skewers the enemy: they are carried on it for 0.7 s, then take a second hit at half damage and are flung off.

transformations.name: Dancer
transformations.description: Every 5 s, when the enemy is close, whirl your spear through a fast full turn (like Spin Swipe) for 30% more damage.

transformations.name: Bouncer
transformations.description: Landing a hit sends out a repelling pulse as far as your spear reaches, dealing 3 damage and throwing enemies straight away from you (at most once a second).

transformations.name: Olympian
transformations.description: Charge Dash becomes Spear Throw: stand still and hurl your spear until it sticks in the wall, piercing every enemy in its path for double damage and huge knockback. Then dash to it, ramming enemies on the way. Unarmed until you pull it out.

transformations.name: Tactician
transformations.description: Your spear head is longer, and hits with it always crit. Hits with the shaft deal 40% less damage.

transformations.name: Tackler
transformations.description: When your spear clashes with a weapon or shield, the enemy's guard breaks for 2.5 s: their weapon and shields can't block, and weapons pass straight through them.

transformations.name: Runner
transformations.description: Charge Dash becomes Flame Lap: charge along a straight line, out through the wall ahead and back in from the wall behind, until you are back where you started, ramming enemies on the way. The line catches fire from wall to wall, setting enemies burning. With Olympian, your thrown spear sets its path on fire instead.

transformations.name: Rogue
transformations.description: Every 6th hit you land readies a vanish: the next hit you would take misses completely as you teleport away from the attacker.

transformations.name: Thief
transformations.description: Whenever your ball bumps into an enemy, steal 20% of their next hit's damage (up to 60%). Your next hit deals what you stole on top.

transformations.name: Saw
transformations.description: Dash Flurry becomes Buzzsaw: launch your daggers as a spinning saw that chases the enemy for 2 s, landing a light hit (40% damage) every 0.1 s while it's on them. It grinds through weapons but not shields. Then it flies back. You're unarmed until it returns.

transformations.name: Trickster
transformations.description: Every 1.5 s, when the enemy is close, throw one of your daggers like a boomerang. It curves out and back, dealing 3 damage to enemies it passes through each way. Throws alternate between your daggers, and you spin one short until it returns.

transformations.name: Multidexterous
transformations.description: Gain a third dagger.

transformations.name: Slippery
transformations.description: 20% chance for a hit on you to slide right off: no damage, and you squirt away from the attacker. Rolled separately from dodging.

transformations.name: Careful
transformations.description: Every parry adds +1 damage to your next hit (up to +6).

transformations.name: Axeman
transformations.description: Swap your daggers for hatchets: twice as thick, so they hit and block much more, and they deal 25% more damage.

transformations.name: Portaler
transformations.description: The first time Drop Slam reaches the floor, it goes through a portal and comes out of the ceiling at full speed for a second fall. It lands the second time. Drop Slam's cooldown is 60% longer.

transformations.name: Valkyrie
transformations.description: While Drop Slam falls you spread a wing on each side, and each one swings a mace: twice the maces for the whole fall. The wings also steer three times as well, towards whichever mace is closer.

transformations.name: Metalworker
transformations.description: Every 0.5 s you go without dealing damage, taking damage or parrying, you hammer your mace: +0.5 damage on your next hit (up to +4).

transformations.name: Pilot
transformations.description: Drop Slam can also go up: from low down, rocket up to the ceiling instead, gaining damage with height the same way.

transformations.name: Crusher
transformations.description: A Drop Slam hit stuns the enemy for 2.5 s: they deal 30% damage and move at 30% speed until it wears off.

transformations.name: Rubber Mace
transformations.description: A Drop Slam hit sends the enemy flying at huge speed for 1.2 s, taking 3 damage every time they hit a wall.

transformations.name: Kamikaze
transformations.description: When Drop Slam hits the floor you explode: enemies within 140 px take 40% of the damage the slam would have dealt, and are blown away.

transformations.name: Devil
transformations.description: When Drop Slam hits the floor, a pillar of fire erupts under your mace for 2.5 s. Enemies in it burn for 1 damage every 0.5 s, and keep burning for 2 s after they leave.

transformations.name: Non-Euclidean
transformations.description: Attacking drones fly out through a wall and back in through the opposite one instead of turning back, and go through the walls to reach the enemy when that way is shorter. A drone that came through a wall lands a critical hit.

transformations.name: Ace
transformations.description: Instead of guarding when an enemy comes within reach, your drones in formation turn their thrusters on it and pull you away. They no longer take anything off hits.

transformations.name: Legion
transformations.description: Twice as many drones, built twice as fast up to twice as many, but each one is smaller and deals and guards only 60% as much.

transformations.name: Fighters
transformations.description: Launched drones no longer ram: they circle the enemy, shooting it (each shot deals 60% of a hit) until an enemy blade or drone swats them or 3 s pass. Blades, shields and enemy drones stop the shots.

transformations.name: Daredevils
transformations.description: Your drones boost at the enemy and back to you 50% faster, leaving short fire trails that set enemies burning (0.5 damage every 0.5 s for 1 s).

transformations.name: Slicers
transformations.description: A drone that hits an enemy latches on and grinds, dealing 40% of its damage every 0.25 s. The enemy shakes it off by bouncing off a wall, clashing its weapon with anything, or hitting you.

transformations.name: Fortress
transformations.description: Your drones are 30% bigger and armored: it takes two swats to knock one away (the first only deflects it), and each guarding drone takes twice as much off a hit. They fly 10% slower and deal 10% less damage.

transformations.name: Wingmen
transformations.description: Two bumper drones fly on your wings. They never attack or guard: when an enemy closes in on you, one rams it, bouncing it away from you and knocking its weapon into spinning the other way. Enemy blades swat them like your other drones.
